subject: Request: temporary egress carveout & hybrid hosting terms for Medicorp pilot
messages:
From: Sarah Wong <sarah.wong@medicorp.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonah Patel <jonah.patel@medicorp.ai>
Date: 2026-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private pilot ask — hybrid VPC + short egress access for auditors

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency and cost profile. We want to run a 3-month pilot for ingestion + chat features in our APAC region. Two ask items from our security/compliance side before legal will sign: 

1) A hybrid hosting model where the inference runtime runs in our VPC (private subnets) but Redwood manages control plane.
2) A short, timeboxed egress allowance (30–90 days) to allow our external auditors to pull snapshots for a one-time SOC readiness assessment. The auditors will only pull a defined set of logs and a sanitized dataset.

Attached is our preliminary SAQ and the list of IP ranges the auditors will use. We understand this is non-standard — looking for a pragmatic route so we can start the pilot next month.

Would you please let us know what approvals and concessions Redwood would need? Pricing is secondary — we just need to confirm the hosting and audit constraints are feasible.

Best,
Sarah Wong
Head of Platform Security, Medicorp AI

Attachments: Medicorp_SAQ.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-01T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private pilot ask — hybrid VPC + short egress access for auditors

Team — forwarding Medicorp's ask. Quick summary: APAC pilot, wants control-plane-managed hybrid hosting (their VPC, our runtime), and a 30–90 day egress window for auditors to pull snapshots. They explicitly asked for pragmatic path to unblock pilot start next month.

Questions for review:
- Feasibility: can we support runtime inside customer-owned VPC with limited egress for a short window? Karthik, how much engineering work and risk?
- Controls: what guardrails do we need (IP allowlist, signed NDA for auditors, read-only snapshot API, redaction requirements)?
- Commercial: I'm proposing a one-time pilot concession — 20% off pilot MRC or a credit equivalent. Marissa, is that within playbook or does this need Deal Desk + Exec?

I'd like to get an exec thumbprint by EOD tomorrow so we can respond to the customer and scope the SOW. Draft reply below that we can send once aligned.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

> On 2026-05-01 09:12, Sarah Wong wrote:
> > (original message quoted)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-01T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private pilot ask — hybrid VPC + short egress access for auditors

Irene / team — quick technical read:

Feasibility: yes, we can run the inference runtime in a customer VPC (private subnets) with our control plane communicating over an approved egress channel. Work items:
- Prep a lightweight deployment playbook (2–3 engineer days)
- Implement an auditor IP allowlist + timebound ACLs (config change + change control)
- Add snapshot export with enforced field redaction and tokenization rules (to avoid PII leaks)

Risk/mitigation:
- We should require the auditors to sign a scoped auditor NDA and accept a limited-scope exhibit that restricts data use.
- Limit snapshot export to a sanitized view and rate-limit exports.
- Short window: suggest 60 days as compromise (30 may be tight for scheduling).

Commercial ask: a pilot concession is reasonable for a new platform reference in APAC. Recommend 20% off pilot fees OR a $35k credit (whichever is simpler contracting-wise). Anything more will need Deal Desk + Exec.

I attached a small config sample for the networking and the export job (redwood_private_config.yml).

Karthik
Head of Inference Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_private_config.yml

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-01T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Exec review request — Medicorp pilot concessions (20% pilot concession + 60-day egress window)

Rishi — quick ask from Deal Desk / Solutions: Medicorp (APAC) wants a short, timeboxed egress carveout for auditors and runtime in their VPC for a 3-month pilot. Technical says feasible with guardrails. Commercial recommends a 20% pilot concession or $35k credit.

Summary of proposed concessions:
- 60-day timeboxed egress window limited to an allowlisted auditor IP range and pre-approved export job
- Enforce snapshot redaction rules and read-only export artifacts; auditors must sign an auditor NDA and restricted exhibit
- Pilot pricing concession: 20% off pilot MRC (or $35k credit) — one-time, non-recurring; full pricing thereafter if they proceed to reserved Dedicated capacity

We need your executive OK to confirm the concession and sign the limited exhibit. If approved, we'll prepare the SOW + Exhibit and request Legal to add an expiration clause (pilot must start within 30 days of signing).

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345-0742
Proposed reply to Medicorp (drafted) below — I can send once we have your go/no-go.

Thanks,
Irene

> Draft reply to customer:
> Hi Sarah — thanks for the clarity. We can support a hybrid deployment in your VPC and provide a 60-day, timeboxed export window for approved auditors under the following conditions: (1) auditor NDA + restricted exhibit; (2) exports limited to sanitized snapshots and IP allowlist; (3) pilot concession of 20% off pilot fees. We will follow up with a technical checklist and SOW.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-02T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec review request — Medicorp pilot concessions (20% pilot concession + 60-day egress window)

Irene / team — I reviewed the ask and Karthik's mitigations. Approve the one-time pilot concession (20% or $35k credit) and the 60-day timeboxed export on the conditions listed below: 

Conditions for approval:
- Auditor NDA and restricted exhibit completed and countersigned before export starts
- Exports must go through the redaction pipeline and be validated by our security team (Karthik to coordinate)
- Pilot pricing concession is non-recurring and expires if pilot doesn't start within 30 days of SOW signature
- Legal to add a clause limiting liability for exported artifacts and to require return/destruction of artifacts after audit window

Marissa — please loop Deal Desk & Legal and update the HubSpot deal to reflect the approved concession and the conditional items. Karthik / Dev — please prepare the deployment playbook and the export validation checklist.

Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
